modelText:
DESCRIPTION:
Oral, 1-compartment, linear clearance (Scenario A; Schoemaker et al. 2019, psp4.12471 sparse benchmark)

[LONGITUDINAL]
input = {Vd, CL, Ka}

PK:
compartment(cmt = 1, amount = Ad)
compartment(cmt = 2, amount = Ac)
iv(cmt = 1, adm = 1, p = 1)

EQUATION:
;;; Explicit functions
Cc = Ac/Vd

;;; Initial conditions
Ad_0 = 0
Ac_0 = 0

;;; ODEs
ddt_Ad = -Ka*Ad
ddt_Ac = Ka*Ad - CL*Cc

OUTPUT:
output = {Cc}
